messages:
amanda: Heads-up — final call for v1.8.2 release: SDK docs regen + console site deploy need to happen before cutoff in ~6h. Please confirm PRs, version bump, and changelog entries :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Diego: On my TODO. I'll re-run the docs regen script and push updated SDK docs. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/198 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/722

maya: Quick question — are we doing a patch (1.8.2) only? no feature flags?

ivan: Patch only. changelog must include the embedding batching fix and release notes for console routing. I'll add a short blurb.

amanda: Perfect. Diego, can you also bump the SDK package version in package.json? Example:
```
# from repo root
sed -i 's/"version": "1.8.1"/"version": "1.8.2"/' packages/sdk/package.json
```

Diego: Yep. Will do and open a tiny PR for the bump + changelog. Ping reviewers: @maya @ivan :eyes:

deploy-bot: Scheduled docs-site deploy window at 2026-02-15T22:00:00Z to 2026-02-15T22:15:00Z. Channel: eng-releases.

maya: I can review the changelog now. If anyone needs me to LGTM the SDK docs regen PR after it's green, ping me.

amanda: Also reminder: console docs build uses the search index update — run:
```
./scripts/build-docs.sh --update-search
```
Diego, add export SENTRY_RELEASE if you want source maps linked.

Diego: Noted. I'll run build and drop a comment in the PR with the build output. If any link breaks, we roll back the docs deploy and re-run staging publish. :+1:

ivan: One more: make sure the release notes include the changelog entry id: #CH-7542 so support can triage.

amanda: Thanks team. If you can confirm by EOD I'll cut the branch and tag. Otherwise fallback plan: postpone to next window. :rocket:
